name: Geu Kkochgil, Nangmanui Gilog
source:
You are kicked out by your landlord out of the blue. Just as you despair over having nowhere to go, you happen to receive a sweet invitation from the share house "Flower Lane" where campus celebrities live. Will this be the start of a blossoming new relationship?

[From in-app]
